meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发智能体的特殊工作模式,加载预先设定的规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Codex 且希望它遵守你的自定义工作规则
copy.tagline_en: Trigger a special agent mode and load its predefined rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want it to follow your custom working rules.

howto.what: 提示中出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时,Claude进入该模式:第一行强制显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,再按规则执行——定目标、记笔记、列待办,按任务大小选轻量或重量流程,并用真实测试证据证明完成。
howto.when: 当提示中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修复这个登录 bug,先写失败测试。
启动 ulw,给接口加超时重试,附验证证据。
say.note: Claude 会记录计划并捕获真实测试证据。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork,重构这段代码,做完展示测试结果。
say.note: 它会按重量流程,跑多个测试场景。

howto.what_en: On “ultrawork” or “ulw”, Claude enters ultrawork mode: first line “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”, then follows the directive — outcome-first, evidence-driven, tiered (light/heavy), proven by real RED→GREEN tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a prompt contains “ultrawork” or “ulw” — the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a bootstrap pointing at this file.

say_en.text: Fix this login bug in ultrawork mode; write the failing test first.
Start ulw, add timeout/retry to the endpoint, attach verification evidence.
say_en.note: It logs the plan and captures real test evidence.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork, refactor this code, then show the test run.
say_en.note: It takes the heavy path with more test scenarios.
